sections.title: First Year Seminar: How and When to be Bored: Literature and Attention
sections.description: This first-year seminar will examine attention, distraction, and boredom in late eighteenth-century Britain and beyond. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
